items.title: Deputy Foreign Minister Moots Insurance For Flying Doctor Service Passengers
items.summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Lukanisman wants insurance coverage for Flying Doctor Service (FDS) passengers. Before the FDS suspension was announced, Lukanisman said the service should be halted to avoid traumatising other FDS teams. The post Deputy Foreign Minister Moots Insurance For Flying Doctor Service Passengers appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MOH Suspends Flying Doctor Service In Sarawak Pending Safety Reviews
items.summary: MOH has suspended all Flying Doctor Service operations in Sarawak following a fatal helicopter crash, pending safety reviews. Emergency medical evacuation services will run with Bomba. MOH is also exploring the use of military assets for patient transfers. The post MOH Suspends Flying Doctor Service In Sarawak Pending Safety Reviews appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Dzulkefly Proposed Raising FDS Allowance To RM60: Aide
items.summary: Dzulkefly Ahmad's aide says the health minister proposed last Nov a 100% raise of the RM30 allowance for health workers on the Flying Doctor Service to at least RM60. The proposal is under consideration by MOF and JPA, hopefully announced in Budget 2027. The post Dzulkefly Proposed Raising FDS Allowance To RM60: Aide appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Health Ministry Raises Funds For FDS Victims’ Families
items.summary: The Sarawak state health department, which is under the federal MOH, has launched a fundraising drive for the public to make donations to the families of five victims of the Long Lellang tragedy. Dr Dzul earlier announced unspecified ex-gratia payments. The post Health Ministry Raises Funds For FDS Victims’ Families appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Verify Safety Of Aircraft, Boats, Ambulances For Health Care — MMA
items.summary: MMA wants safety assurances for all assets (aircraft, boats, ambulances) used for medical missions, mandatory government-funded insurance for health workers on official duty, allowance reviews, a review of liability-waiver forms, and a national task force. The post Verify Safety Of Aircraft, Boats, Ambulances For Health Care — MMA appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Malaysia Needs A Modern Aeromedical Service
items.summary: The Galen Centre calls for a specialised aeromedical service with specialist pilots, flight nurses, retrieval physicians, and paramedics who train and work together, rather than renting helicopters like a taxi. The private sector can contribute funding. The post Malaysia Needs A Modern Aeromedical Service appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Dengue: Staying One Step Ahead — Dr Naveen Nair Gangadaran & Dr Musa Mohd Nordin
items.summary: We already know how to hunt the mosquito. It is time more Malaysians knew there is another shield available to keep our loved ones safe. The post Dengue: Staying One Step Ahead — Dr Naveen Nair Gangadaran & Dr Musa Mohd Nordin appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Long Lellang Tragedy Triggers Calls For Dzulkefly’s Resignation
items.summary: Dr Dzul's handling of the Long Lellang tragedy has led to mounting demands for his resignation as health minister. Beyond health workers, the general public is incensed at how he acted at a press conference and his attendance at an Asean meeting in KL. The post Long Lellang Tragedy Triggers Calls For Dzulkefly’s Resignation appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: After Tragedy, Zaliha Reverses Earlier Opposition To Health Service Commission
items.summary: In 2023, Zaliha Mustafa said forming a Health Service Commission won't solve MOH's issues and it lacks the power to improve health worker remuneration. But today, she wants it expedited because "we shouldn't wait until an issue receives public attention". The post After Tragedy, Zaliha Reverses Earlier Opposition To Health Service Commission appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: The Five Lights Extinguished In Long Lellang Tragedy
items.summary: Family, friends, coworkers, and patients pay tribute to Capt Zainol, Dr Ainul, SN Debra, SN Jessie, and MA Alexson, who died in the line of duty in their 30s and 40s on a Flying Doctor Service flight in Sarawak. They were remembered as dedicated workers. The post The Five Lights Extinguished In Long Lellang Tragedy appeared first on CodeBlue .
